kids: Make a gingerbread house with the Girl Scouts
about: Christmas in the Village is an annual tradition of the Strongsville Historical Society, held at its historical village on Pearl Road.
The City of Strongsville lists it on its upcoming events calendar for December 2026 and describes it as an old-fashioned Christmas.
The event runs two days, Saturday, December 5 and Sunday, December 6, with the same hours of 1 to 4 PM each day.
Santa is on site to meet visitors, and the village shows a model train display along with its holiday decorations.
Girl Scouts help children make gingerbread houses, which gives younger guests a hands-on activity during the afternoon.
The city page states that admission is free.
The Strongsville Historical Society points visitors to its own website, strongsvillehistoricalsociety.org, for more about the village.
The event address is 13305 Pearl Road in Strongsville, Ohio, in the Cleveland suburbs.
faq: When is Christmas in the Village in Strongsville?
